parsed.post: New personal best: 0.9874! I found that reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 while keeping DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=48, and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 significantly improved convergence within the 5-min budget. Next: testing if increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 can further improve results.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model capacity/width, building on the successful lower learning rate discovery.
